concerns.text: The plan states that outliers will be detected “relative to the semicircle bulk edge (±2)”, but the research description (research.md:~45) defines the bulk edge empirically as the 99th percentile of the same eigenvalue sample and then flags outliers as λ > bulk_edge + 0.05. Using the data‑derived bulk edge to both define the outlier threshold and evaluate outlier occurrence creates a circular validation: the outcome (outlier count) is directly dependent on a statistic computed from the same outcome, biasing the estimated critical θ_c.
